title: Shower Door Pull 13-Inch Solid Brass & Acrylic | Unlacquered Brass | Brass Shower Door Accessories | Allied Brass
description:
Make your glass shower door easier to open and close with a sturdy, clean-lined shower door pull (also called a shower door handle or shower door grip) built for everyday bathroom use in Unlacquered Brass, which is a living finish that develops a unique natural patina over time, gaining character and warmth with age. Each piece becomes one-of-a-kind, perfect for those who appreciate authentic materials that tell a story.

Highlights:
- Unlacquered Brass develops a unique, one-of-a-kind patina over time
- Choose from 84 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Choose durable materials for a wet space with solid brass construction and clear acrylic accent components
- Coordinate with transitional bathroom hardware and other versatile bath accessories in the Brass Shower Door Accessories collection
- Match your bathroom style with multiple designer finish options

Specs & Installation:
- Product: Clearview Collection single side shower door pull with smooth accents
- Use: Ideal for glass shower doors of all sizes and styles
- Materials: Solid brass; acrylic accents
- Mounting style: Wall mount / wall-mounted / wall-hanging with concealed screw mounting (hardware included)
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 13 x 3.9 x 1.7 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 14 x 6 x 6 in.
- Shipping weight: 4 lbs
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
